target_units.text: For if you sit, you will be fearless, and if you sleep, you will sleep pleasantly.
You will not fear an approaching fright or the oncoming assaults of the ungodly,
for the Lord will be upon all your ways and support your foot so that you are not shaken.

target_units.text: and Jehu found the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah. He said, ‘Who are you?’ They said, ‘We are Ahaziah’s brothers, and we have come down for the peace of the king’s sons and the ruling lady’s sons.’
He said, ‘Seize them alive.’ They seized them alive and slaughtered them at Baithakad, forty-two men. He left not one of them.
